snippet.title: Chakana - Trailer
snippet.description:
The will be available on Steam and Itch.io
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4105240/Chakana/


Bound to a brutal loop of murders, you are forced to clean up every crime scene and wipe the evidence. Investigate the origin of the mysterious pocket pet that controls your fate.
